text:
marie (content): Heads-up — we're running a tiny live workshop + refapp demo for CodeGarden next Wed. Goal: 30-50 engaged signups, 10 demo conversions. Need: launch post copy, 1 benchmark narrative (latency/cost), webinar flow, and inbound lead routing.
jamal (growth): I can do the leadflow. Suggest gated registration + autopush to Drift + Segment trait. Low lift: a short gating form with 3 fields.
akshay (product-marketing): Benchmark angle = 'local inference on 1 GPU vs hosted: matching quality at 40% lower cost for dev workflows' — show 3 short test cases (chat, completion, embedding). Keep one chart.
nora (devrel): I'll own the refapp demo steps and 10-min live walkthrough. Can prerecord the heavy model run and show live UX + how to swap to Dedicated.
sophia (design): I'll make 2 hero images: 1 for the launch post, 1 for the webinar landing. Also a 1-slide visual for the benchmark callout.
marie (content): Draft post copy idea — short hero + TL;DR bullet with the benchmark stat + CTA to 'Register'. Example copy:
"Join our CodeGarden workshop — build a tiny refapp that serves embeddings and chat with Redwood. See cost/latency tradeoffs in a short benchmark, and get the repo + starter prompts."
jamal (growth): Lead routing details — post-registration: Segment identify, tag "codegarden_workshop", then webhook to Drift with plan: immediate convo for enterprise signals, otherwise drip 3 emails over 10 days. Slack alert to #sales-inbound for anyone from target domains.
marie (content): Example UTM / tracking to include in post link:
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=codegarden_2026&utm_content=launch
```
akshay (product-marketing): For the benchmark, we should record metrics: median p95 latency, tokens/sec, and $/K tokens. Small table + one chart. Keep methodology note: same prompt set, batch size tuned, and quantized variant.
nora (devrel): For the demo script (6 slides + 10-min live): 1) intro; 2) quick refapp overview; 3) run hosted path; 4) swap to dedicated; 5) benchmark reveal; 6) how to get the starter kit. I'll drop a playbook in the repo.
sophia (design): Preference for image tone: developer-first, clear numbers, avoid marketing jargon. Use our blue + green palette.
marie (content): Copy rounds — I'll push a first draft by EOD Monday. jamal, can you wire the Drift + Segment flow before Tuesday so landing page tests traffic?
jamal (growth): Yep. I'll set up the webhook and a basic Drift playbook. Also adding a hidden field to capture company size for prioritization.
marie (content): Quick checklist for the team: 1) landing + registration; 2) post copy; 3) hero + benchmark visual; 4) prerecord demo clip; 5) lead routing + slack alert; 6) tweet + devforum snippet. Anyone want to add?
akshay (product-marketing): Add a one-paragraph developer note for the post on 'how we measured' — keeps us honest and useful for reproducibility.
marie (content): Good call. nora — can you pin the repo link here once ready?
nora (devrel): Will do. Repo will include scripted benchmark (collected commands), Dockerfile, and a 1-click sample for Hosted + Dedicated.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy of the landing page preview at 2026-06-02T09:00Z — status: queued.
marie (content): Perfect — meeting-free lane for this thread. I'll ping again with the draft. :sparkles:
_notes: Follow-up: final copy & landing test before paid promos.
